jobs.title: Data Scientist (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
More about the role

Join our R&D organization and help build a deep understanding of how our products are used in the real world. This role sits in a technical team and focuses on translating complex product and user data into clear, decision-shaping insights for functional owners, senior leadership and product marketing.

In this role, you will:

• Lead the analysis of product usage data to uncover meaningful patterns, behaviors, and segmentations

• Build a deep understanding of our datasets and apply statistical methods to generate robust, decision-relevant insights

• Translate complex technical findings into clear recommendations that support R&D decisions, product direction, and business priorities

• Communicate usage insights in a simple, credible, and actionable way to technical teams, senior leaders, and product marketing stakeholders

• Create practical analyses and dashboards that make product usage visible and easier to act on

• Partner closely with R&D teams, engineering, product management, senior leaders, and product marketing to frame the right questions and connect data to decisions

• Stay current on relevant developments in analytics, statistics, and AI, and apply them where they improve insight quality and business value

More about you

• Master’s degree or PhD in Psychology, Behavioral Science, Health Science, Audiology, or a related field

• Several years of experience in data science, product analytics, user insights, or a similar role

• Strong expertise in statistics, segmentation, behavioral analysis, and extracting insight from complex real-world datasets

• Strong hands-on skills in Python and dashboarding, with the ability to move between strategic insight generation and practical delivery

• Proven ability to translate deep technical analysis into clear recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders

• Experience working with complex datasets and turning them into clear recommendations for non-technical stakeholders

• Confidence working with R&D and engineering stakeholders while also communicating clearly with senior leaders and product marketing

• Experience in MedTech, healthcare, or another scientific or regulated environment is a plus

• Clear, structured communication and a strong instinct for connecting data to product and business decisions

• Fluent in English

More about what we offer

As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. We want to create an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work, through our flexible hybrid working model.

We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both your professional and personal development, and there are exceptional growth opportunities with individual development plans.

jobs.title: Sound Quality Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
As a Sound Quality Engineer , you will be developing audiological features, evaluating, optimizing, and verifying the sound quality and performance of Sonova's hearing solutions.

Working closely with experts across R&D teams and the marketing department, you will translate innovative technologies into measurable end-user benefits and excellent hearing experiences that improve the lives of millions.

More about the role:

• Develop and maintain hearing device features to deliver exceptional user benefits and outstanding listening experiences.

• Parameterize hearing device functions using MATLAB, Simulink or Python and optimize performance to meet speech intelligibility and sound quality requirements.

• Use AI methods and tools to develop and optimize audiological features and evaluate sound performance of DNN-based solutions.

• Build firmware images and measure performance of hearing devices in an acoustic test box, a fully equipped acoustic lab (with KEMAR), or a dedicated electrical audio setup and provide evidence-backed performance metrics.

• Define the metrics and evaluation methods and develop tests for sound quality and feature performance evaluation.

• Create audio recordings with hearing devices and dedicated equipment to prepare stimuli for device testing.

• Conduct experiments with subjects to understand subjective performance in real-world scenarios.

• Contribute to feature integration and system verification activities, conduct tests and provide expert feedback on device sound performance.

• Closely collaborate with audiological research, signal processing, AI, data insights, software engineering, and other R&D teams.

• Support the marketing department by providing improvement ideas, claims metrics, conducting competitive intelligence studies and preparing technical setups for sound demos.

More about you:

Must-have:

• Higher-level degree in science or engineering (Electrical Engineering, Physics, Acoustics, Biomedical Engineering, or a comparable technical or scientific discipline).

• Strong knowledge in one or more of the following areas: sound engineering, signal processing, acoustics, audiology, or electro-acoustic.

• At least 3 years of professional experience in engineering, acoustics, signal processing, or a comparable R&D environment.

• Skilled in one or more of the following tools: MATLAB, Python, XML, Audio editing tools (e.g. Adobe Audition, ProTools, Reaper or similar).

• Intellectually curious, proactive, and solution-oriented, with strong analytical thinking and sound judgment.

• Collaborative, reliable, and fun to work with, building trust and strong relationships across teams.

• Professional working proficiency in English.

Nice to have:

• Experience within the medical device industry or other regulated development environments.

• Experience in hearing technology or audiology-related products.

• Skilled in AI tool for sound engineering or signal processing

More about what we offer:

As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. We want to create an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work, through our flexible hybrid working model. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both your professional and personal development, and there are exceptional growth opportunities with individual development plans.

jobs.description:
As a Product Cybersecurity Expert , you will play a key role in ensuring cybersecurity is embedded into the development of Sonova's connected hearing solutions—from embedded software and mobile applications to cloud-based services.

Working closely with software engineers, product teams, architects, quality, and regulatory experts, you'll help integrate security into every stage of the product development lifecycle. Rather than focusing on operational security, you'll enable engineering teams to build secure products by design, balancing innovation, usability, compliance, and customer trust.

If you have a strong software engineering background and have expanded your expertise into product cybersecurity, this is an opportunity to shape technologies that improve the lives of millions of people worldwide.

More about the role

• Integrate cybersecurity throughout the Secure Software Development Lifecycle (Secure SDLC) for connected medical devices, embedded software, mobile applications, and cloud services.

• Lead threat modeling activities, cybersecurity risk assessments, and mitigation planning together with global R&D teams.

• Partner with software engineering teams to embed security into development workflows, DevSecOps practices, and CI/CD pipelines.

• Coordinate product vulnerability management activities, including assessment, prioritization, remediation tracking, and post-market monitoring.

• Support regulatory submissions and quality processes by preparing cybersecurity documentation and evidence.

• Advise engineering, product management, quality, and regulatory teams on practical, risk-based cybersecurity decisions.

• Promote a security-first mindset by coaching teams, supporting security champions, and driving continuous improvement across R&D.

More about you

Essential

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical experience).

• 5+ years of experience in software engineering, software architecture, product development, Secure SDLC, or a comparable software development environment.

• At least 3 years of hands-on experience in product cybersecurity or application security.

• Strong understanding of Secure Software Development Lifecycle (Secure SDLC) and how cybersecurity integrates into modern software development.

• Experience working closely with software development teams throughout the product lifecycle.

• Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex security topics to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Professional working proficiency in English.

Nice to have

• Experience developing software for medical devices or other regulated industries.

• Experience with DevSecOps and security integration into CI/CD pipelines.

• Knowledge of cybersecurity standards and regulations such as IEC 81001-5-1, IEC 62304, ISO 14971, MDR, FDA, GDPR, CRA or similar frameworks.

• Security certifications such as CISSP, CSSLP, GIAC, or equivalent.

• Experience with cloud security, cryptography, authentication technologies, or software supply chain security.

• Familiarity with Privacy by Design principles, AI agent security, and AI-supported development environments.

More about what we offer

As one of the world's leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we're committed to building an inclusive culture where innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning thrive.

Joining Sonova means working with highly skilled international teams developing technologies that genuinely improve people's quality of life. We offer a flexible hybrid working model, extensive learning and development opportunities, and clear career paths that support both your professional and personal growth.

Here, you'll have the opportunity to shape secure, connected healthcare technologies while working in an environment where your ideas are valued and your impact is visible.

In this role, you will take technical ownership of the Charging Solutions domain, covering electronics, embedded software, mechanical interfaces and connectivity across the wider product ecosystem. More about the role

• Take technical and architectural ownership of the Charging Solutions domain, guiding the development team, setting priorities and supporting effective delivery.

• Design charging architectures spanning electronics and embedded software, while ensuring effective integration with mechanical components.

• Define strategic, reusable platform elements and interfaces between chargers, hearing instruments, production software and application software.

Must have

• At least five years of professional experience in hardware and/or embedded software development, including hands-on experience with charging solutions.

• Strong knowledge of electrical hardware and electronic schematics, combined with a solid understanding of embedded software architecture and the ability to review code.

• Experience designing complex hardware–software systems and managing dependencies across electronics, software, mechanics and connected applications.

• A pragmatic and decisive approach, with the ability to navigate uncertainty, evaluate technical trade-offs and drive solutions forward.

• Proven ability to lead cross-functional technical groups and influence internal stakeholders and external suppliers.

• Strong communication and negotiation skills, together with professional fluency in English.

• Experience designing reusable platforms or modular product architectures.

jobs.description:
In our R&D group, we develop hearing solutions and services for hearing impaired people and hearing care professionals in the form of hearing instruments, accessories, web services, mobile applications and PC software. From the concept to the deployment phase, you will be engaged in contributing to highly flexible and reliable software and firmware solutions.

As a Software Engineer DSP - Tools & Infrastructure, you will drive the design, implementation and maintenance of SW tools for embedded audio signal processing. These tools enable model-based functional development, and embedded application-level development. They address the needs arising in embedded software development for a multi-processor embedded system dedicated to signal- and neural-network processing.

More about the role

•
 Design and evolve software development tools that enable model-based and embedded functional software development for signal- and neural-network processing

•
 Collaborate with stakeholders to gather, analyze, and refine requirements for design and implementation of software development tools

•
 Actively support the communication and collaboration between the teams that develop the tools and the teams that use the tools

•
 Drive software engineering best practices through design reviews, technical guidelines, and continuous improvement

•
 Contribute to architectural qualities in support of conceptual integrity, modularity, maintainability and extensibility

More about you

•
 University degree (MSc/BSc) or equivalent in computer science, electrical engineering or related technical field

•
 4+ years of experience in the development, deployment and maintenance of embedded software systems

•
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

•
 Proficiency in Python

•
 Experience with Matlab & Simulink

•
 Knowledge of one (or more) of the following technologies: C/C++, Docker, CI/CD (e.g. Jenkins), Bash

•
 Good understanding of signal processing development, knowledge on Neural Network development is a plus

•
 Experience with real-time signal processing systems is a plus

•
 Collaborative mindset with a customer and service-oriented approach

•
 Fluent skills in English; German is a plus

More about what we offer

As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. We want to create an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work, through our flexible hybrid working model. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both your professional and personal development, and there are exceptional growth opportunities with individual development plans.

Application process

Magdalena Suszek, Talent Acquisition Partner, is looking forward to receiving your application via our online job application platform, including your CV and cover letter. For this vacancy, only direct applications will be considered.

• Erfahrung in der Elektronikproduktion, idealerweise mit Kenntnissen in Lean Management, Supply Chain und SMD/Flip-Chip-Bestückung

This position sits at the crossroads of multiple technical domains: electronic design, battery innovation, and embedded software, offering a uniquely dynamic environment where your decisions directly shape performance, efficiency, and user experience. • Specify, integrate, and validate power management circuits for rechargeable and non-rechargeable battery systems

• Evaluate, specify, integrate, and optimize Power Management ICs (PMICs) and related power conversion architectures for future hearing instruments and charging systems

• Develop and validate electrical and system-level models for power consumption, load profiles, and battery behavior under different operating conditions

• Analyze and debug complex power-related system issues, driving root-cause identification and resolution

• Evaluate emerging power management technologies and energy management concepts to support future product generations

More about you

• Master’s degree or PhD in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Microelectronics, or a related field

• Experience with rechargeable and non-rechargeable battery technologies, as well as a strong understanding of system-level behavior, load profiling, power consumption analysis, and battery aging effects

• Hands-on experience with electrical characterization, laboratory measurements, and data-driven validation of power systems

• Strong programming skills in Python for data analysis, automation, and model development; MATLAB is a plus

• Experience in optimizing ultra-low-power systems under strict energy and size constraints is an asset

• Structured, proactive, and quality-conscious working style, with the ability to bring forward innovative ideas and collaborate effectively in a distributed, diverse environment

Purpose of the Job

As a Senior Interaction Designer, you will shape the user experience across our ecosystem by acting as the vital bridge between Industrial and Digital Experience Design. Your primary mission is to craft outstanding, state-of-the-art interaction design solutions that deliver a seamless, enjoyable, and accessible user experience across all touchpoints of the hearing care journey—from hearing instruments (HIs) and chargers to mobile apps and software platforms. By harmonizing hardware touchpoints with digital platforms, you will drive ecosystem alignment and ensure consistent, holistic user experience. You will collaborate closely with the Digital Experience and Industrial Design teams, Product Managers, Strategic Marketing, and R&D to design solutions that are simple, intuitive, and meaningful.

Tasks & Responsibilities

• Drive a cohesive end-to-end UX/UI experience, ensuring that physical user interactions seamlessly trigger and align with digital workflows across mobile apps and B2B/B2C solutions.

• Apply User-Centered Design (UCD) and Design Thinking methods across the entire design process, from wireframes, storyboards, and user flows to advanced, interactive prototypes. Utilize these tools to map out customer journeys that simulate the physical-to-digital bridge and align seamlessly with the broader experience design strategy.

• Engage in ongoing user research and design validation to ensure a data-informed, hypothesis-driven approach.

• Actively contributes to design guidelines, metrics, and success criteria at the group level.

• Collaborate with Design, PMs, and R&D to ensure seamless integration across the Sonova ecosystem.

• Actively promote design quality, best practices, and a culture of craft within the team.

Requirements

• University degree in Interaction Design, Experience Design, or similar

• 5+ years designing end-to-end digital products for web and mobile (iOS/Android).

• Expertise in UX research and hypothesis-driven, user-centered methodologies.

• Advanced skills in Figma, and modern AI-powered prototyping tools.

• Excellent communication skills with a proven ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams, influence stakeholders at all levels, and mentor junior team members.

• Strong analytical skills with a data-informed approach to decision-making.

• Self-motivated, organized, and highly effective in fast-paced, complex environments with a passion for continuous innovation and quality.

• Fluent in English (written and spoken).

jobs.title: Senior Manager Product Quality (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Help shape how quality is engineered into products used by millions of people worldwide.

At Sonova, we're looking for an experienced product quality reliability leader to own and evolve our global Critical-to-Quality (CtQ) framework for our Hardware and SW products, ensuring the critical product characteristics are embedded and verified throughout the entire product lifecycle.

Working across Product Development, Manufacturing, Operations, Supplier Quality and Service, you will establish global CtQ governance, drive end-to-end traceability and help shape how innovative hearing solutions are developed over the full product lifecycle.

If you enjoy building frameworks, like reliability engineering activities, train people, working together with other stakeholders and driving continuous improvement in a highly regulated environment, we would love to hear from you.

More about the role

• Own and continuously evolve Sonova's global Critical-to-Quality (CtQ) process, ensuring its implementation and effectiveness across the entire product lifecycle.

• Establish and drive global CtQ governance, standards and best practices across product development, manufacturing, supplier and service.

• Partner with Product Development teams to ensure Critical-to-Quality characteristics and Reliability Engineering principles are considered from the earliest stages of product development.

• Lead cross-functional CtQ reviews, aligning R&D, Manufacturing, Supplier Quality and Service around critical reliability requirements.

• Ensure end-to-end traceability of Critical-to-Quality attributes from product requirements and design through verification, validation, manufacturing and field performance.

• Integrate CtQ requirements into key quality processes, including Design-, Process-, Service FMEA and Safety Risk Management and product development activities.

• Ensure field performance, reliability and customer insights will feed back to CtQs to continuously improve product quality and future product generations.

• Drive continuous improvement of CtQ methodologies, tools and KPIs.

More about you

• A degree in Engineering, Quality, Science or another technical discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

• Extensive experience in Product Development, Reliability Engineering, Design Quality, Manufacturing Engineerng or Operational Excellence within a highly regulated industry, ideally Medical Devices, Aerospace or Automotive.

• Hands-on experience leading the practical application of APQP, PPAP, FMEA and Lean initiatives to improve overall product quality.

• Strong knowledge of Quality Management Systems with hands-on experience in ISO 9001; experience with ISO 13485, ISO 14971, and IEC 62304 is an advantage.

• Experience working cross-functionally with R&D, Product Development and Manufacturing teams throughout the product lifecycle is highly desirable.

• A curious, pragmatic and entrepreneurial mindset, combined with excellent stakeholder management, communication and presentation skills.

• Fluent English; German is a plus.

More about what we offer

As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we are committed to building an inclusive culture where you can balance a successful career with your life outside of work through our flexible hybrid working model. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both professional and personal development, with strong growth opportunities supported by individual development plans.

Application process

Magdalena Suszek, Talent Acquisition Partner, is looking forward to receiving your application via our online job application platform, including your CV and cover letter. For this vacancy, only direct applications will be considered.

As an Audiology Innovation Manager, you will be the audiological expert for an assigned product portfolio. You will connect clinical expertise, product development, scientific evidence, and marketing to help deliver solutions that create meaningful benefits for hearing care professionals and consumers.

Working closely with R&D, Business Units, product and launch teams, you will provide audiological input throughout the product lifecycle, from early concepts and feature definition to validation, claims substantiation, launch execution, training, and post-launch activities.

More about the role

• Serve as the audiological application specialist and subject matter expert for an assigned product portfolio.

• Build a deep understanding of how products are fitted and used, their audiological performance, and the benefits they provide to target consumer groups.

• Partner with R&D, Business Units, Solutions Management, Marketing Communications, and launch teams to shape product and feature development.

• Define audiological claims and contribute to validation studies, confirmatory studies, benchmarking, and post-market clinical follow-up activities.

• Ensure that product marketing content is audiologically accurate, evidence-based, and appropriately substantiated.

• Create audiological content, training materials, insights, and demonstration tools to support product launches, events, and seasonal campaigns.

• Deliver launch-related train-the-trainer sessions in partnership with the Training Excellence Manager, preparing regional teams for effective and consistent local deployment.

• Partner with the Training Excellence Manager to identify learning needs and translate audiological, scientific, and product information into practical, audience-appropriate learning experiences and resources.

• Monitor customer needs, market trends, performance drivers, and competitive solutions relevant to the portfolio.

• Contribute to professional and scientific communications, including congress presentations, blogs, podcasts, white papers, data insights, and best-practice materials.

• Build relationships with internal and external experts, Group Companies, and Audiological Care.

More about you

Must-have

• A recognized university-level degree in Audiology.

• Clinical experience in hearing aid fitting and rehabilitation.

• A deep understanding of audiological and clinical principles, information, and practices.

• Strong training, presentation, and writing skills.

• The ability to translate complex scientific information into clear, concise, audience-appropriate content.

• Experience working effectively in cross-functional and multicultural environments.

• Strong planning, organizational, communication, and relationship-building skills.

• A solution-oriented, flexible, and results-focused approach.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office and WordPress, with the ability to track and analyze data using Excel and dashboards.

Nice-to-have

• A master’s degree.

• Industry experience.

• An interest in hearing industry digital solutions, such as apps.

• German language skills.

More about what we offer

As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we are committed to building an inclusive culture where you can balance a successful career with your life outside of work through our flexible hybrid working model. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both professional and personal development, with strong growth opportunities supported by individual development plans.

Application process

Magdalena Suszek, Talent Acquisition Partner, is looking forward to receiving your application via our online job application platform, including your CV and cover letter. For this vacancy, only direct applications will be considered.

In qualità di Audiology Innovation Manager, sarai l'esperto audiologico per un portafoglio di prodotti assegnato. Connetterai competenze cliniche, sviluppo di prodotti, prove scientifiche e marketing per aiutare a fornire soluzioni che creano benefici significativi per i professionisti dell'udito e i consumatori.

Lavorando a stretto contatto con R&D, Business Units, team di prodotto e lancio, fornirete input audiologici in tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto, dai primi concetti e dalla definizione delle caratteristiche alla validazione, sostiene la motivazione, esecuzione del lancio, formazione e attività post-lancio.

Ulteriori informazioni sul ruolo

• Servire come specialista di applicazioni audiologiche e soggetto esperto per un portafoglio di prodotti assegnato.

• Costruire una profonda comprensione di come i prodotti sono montati e utilizzati, le loro prestazioni audiologiche, e i vantaggi che forniscono ai gruppi di consumatori target.

• Partner con R&D, Business Units, Solutions Management, Marketing Communications e team di lancio per modellare lo sviluppo di prodotti e funzionalità.

• Definire affermazioni audiologiche e contribuire a studi di convalida, studi di conferma, benchmarking e attività di follow-up clinico post-market.

• Assicurarsi che il contenuto di marketing del prodotto sia audiologicamente accurato, basato su prove, e adeguatamente motivato.

• Crea contenuti audiologici, materiali formativi, approfondimenti e strumenti dimostrativi per supportare lanci di prodotti, eventi e campagne stagionali.

• Fornire sessioni di formazione-the-trainer relative al lancio in collaborazione con il Training Excellence Manager, preparando i team regionali per una distribuzione locale efficace e coerente.

• Partner del Training Excellence Manager per identificare le esigenze di apprendimento e tradurre informazioni audiologiche, scientifiche e di prodotto in esperienze pratiche e risorse di apprendimento appropriate al pubblico.

• Monitorare le esigenze dei clienti, le tendenze del mercato, i driver di performance e le soluzioni competitive pertinenti al portafoglio.

• Contribuisci a comunicazioni professionali e scientifiche, tra cui presentazioni congressuali, blog, podcast, white paper, informazioni di dati e materiali best practice.

• Costruire relazioni con esperti interni ed esterni, Gruppo Aziende e Audiological Care.

Più di te

Devono

• Una laurea riconosciuta a livello universitario in Audiologia.

• Esperienza clinica in apparecchi acustici e riabilitazione.

• Una profonda comprensione dei principi, delle informazioni e delle pratiche audiologiche e cliniche.

• Forte formazione, presentazione e capacità di scrittura.

• La capacità di tradurre informazioni scientifiche complesse in contenuti chiari, concisi e appropriati al pubblico.

• Esperienza di lavoro efficace in ambienti interfunzionali e multiculturali.

• Forte capacità di pianificazione, organizzazione, comunicazione e di costruzione di relazioni.

• Un approccio orientato alla soluzione, flessibile e focalizzato sui risultati.

• Ottimo scritto e parlato inglese.

• Proficienza in Microsoft Office e WordPress, con la capacità di monitorare e analizzare i dati utilizzando Excel e dashboard.

Bello da avere

• Un master.

• Esperienza nel settore.

• Un interesse per le soluzioni digitali dell'industria dell'udito, come le applicazioni.

• competenze linguistiche tedesche.

Maggiori informazioni su ciò che offriamo

Come uno dei principali fornitori di servizi di assistenza acustica al mondo con sede in Svizzera, ci impegniamo a costruire una cultura inclusiva dove è possibile bilanciare una carriera di successo con la vostra vita al di fuori del lavoro attraverso il nostro modello di lavoro ibrido flessibile. • Erleben Sie effektives Arbeiten in funktionsübergreifenden und multikulturellen Umgebungen.

• Starke Planungs-, Organisations-, Kommunikations- und Beziehungsaufbaufähigkeiten.

• Ein lösungsorientierter, flexibler und ergebnisorientierter Ansatz.

• Hervorragend geschriebenes und gesprochenes Englisch.

• Forte formation, présentation et compétences en écriture.

• La capacité de traduire l'information scientifique complexe en contenu clair, concis et adapté au public.

• Expérience de travail efficace dans des environnements interfonctionnels et multiculturels.

• Forte capacité de planification, d'organisation, de communication et d'établissement de relations.

• Une approche axée sur la solution, flexible et axée sur les résultats.

• Excellent écrit et parlé anglais.

• Compétence en Microsoft Office et WordPress, avec la possibilité de suivre et d'analyser les données en utilisant Excel et les tableaux de bord.

jobs.description:
Sonova is seeking a Senior Manager, RIC and BTE Solutions to lead the development and delivery of signal processing solutions across RIC and BTE hearing products. This role provides technical, functional, and people leadership to ensure scalable, high-quality, and product-ready software solutions that support Sonova’s global hearing system platforms.

More about the role

• Lead and own the development, design and integration of signal processing features for Sonova hearing systems

• Provide technical leadership and decision-making authority for signal processing realization

• Drive reuse, scalability, and product readiness across platforms, products, and Sonova brands

• Establish clear cross domain alignment and decision making across departments and areas

• Collaborate closely with Product Management and Project Leaders to ensure customer focus and success in the market

• Lead, develop, and manage a team of software professionals while supporting talent development and succession planning

More about you

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline

• Proven leadership experience in software development and in people leadership within complex R&D environments

• Extensive experience shaping and delivering software features across multiple platforms, product generations, and releases

• Strong understanding of Digital Signal Processing (DSP), system integration, fitting software systems, and regulated product development

• Ability to lead through ambiguity while balancing innovation, scalability, quality, and long-term platform value

• Strong, confident communicator with demonstrated soft skills applied to leadership and collaboration across technical, audiological, and business stakeholders

• Experience working in international, multi-site, and cross-functional environments

• Curious about emerging technologies, particularly AI, with a forward-looking mindset and passion for innovation

• Fluent in English; German is a plus

More about what we offer:

As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. We want to create an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work, through our flexible hybrid working model. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both your professional and personal development, and there are exceptional growth opportunities with individual development plans.

At Sonova, you'll join a global team of innovators dedicated to transforming lives through cutting-edge hearing technology. You'll have the opportunity to:

• Shape the future of signal processing across multiple global hearing instrument brands.

• Lead talented international engineering teams working on technologies that improve the lives of millions of people worldwide.

• Influence long-term platform strategy and drive innovation in a collaborative, global R&D environment.

• Work with passionate experts in software engineering, signal processing, audiology, and product development.

• Grow your career while making a meaningful impact on the future of hearing healthcare.

Application process

Magdalena Suszek, Talent Acquisition Partner, is looking forward to receiving your application via our online job application platform, including your CV and cover letter. For this vacancy, only direct applications will be considered
